name: What's for Dinner? (Jason)
tagline: The classic dinner standoff, playable on demand - every pitch gets vetoed
description: A pure comedy bit, not a planner: ask what is for dinner and you are told anything works, then every suggestion meets a short playful veto. Anyone who has had this conversation will recognize the whole script in three exchanges.
author: Jason
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
